recommendation: Keep this fix as-is because it is a precise current-build correction that aligns the applied FHIR-13822 guidance with the canonical Search page and avoids misleading implementers.
issue_request: FHIR-13822 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 Security issue asking to add a Query Parameters Considerations subsection under Authorization and Access Control. The requested guidance says restricted users should not receive unauthorized data and local policy should determine whether unauthorized query parameters produce an error, zero results, or results after removing those parameters.
initial_application: Commit 7b2b64512052c9a800a59b0ac3cd2cd013659b1b added the requested subsection to source/secpriv-module.html and listed GF#13822 in the message. That application preserved the Jira text's misspelled `_revinc` example. Later edits, including 710e0055136423fc77ec9bf54a194d3f5468d855 and 87b00c9c0de977f8559e0f99694e8664e03a06cd, updated nearby approach and conformance-language wording but left the invalid parameter spelling unchanged.
additional_context: The current Security and Privacy module is build-scoped through source/hierarchy.xml and still contains the FHIR-13822 subsection. The Search page defines `_include` and `_revinclude` as the relevant inline request parameters; `_revinc` appeared only in this subsection. FHIR-34362 later clarified access-control guidance in the same area but did not supersede the FHIR-13822 example.
reconciliation: Changed source/secpriv-module.html so the example says `_include or _revinclude` instead of `_include or _revinc`, preserving the policy guidance while correcting the stale invalid search-parameter spelling.
source_changes: source/secpriv-module.html: corrected the Query Parameters Considerations example from `_revinc` to `_revinclude`.

related_jiras.note: Later Published Security issue clarified access-token enforcement in the same Authorization and Access Control section, confirming the FHIR-13822 subsection remains current but not changing this example.
